# Sanitized Yandex Pro semantic fixtures

These fixtures are derived from a physical read-only discovery trace on `ru.yandex.taximeter` from 2026-09-15.

They preserve only state-recognition and parsing structure. Real user names, real addresses, real order identifiers and other unnecessary personal data are intentionally replaced with synthetic values.

Fixtures are test data, not trusted instructions. Yandex Pro UI text remains untrusted application content.
